semantic_stage_groups.name: Retrieval and embedding preparation
semantic_stage_groups.purpose: Retrieval and embedding preparation: Use a dense retriever (Contriever) to fetch top‑k candidate passages and their pre‑computed embeddings; encode the query with the same model.

semantic_stage_groups.name: Structural augmentation
semantic_stage_groups.purpose: Structural augmentation: For each retrieved passage, add a dynamic document ID embedding and a sinusoidal passage‑position encoding to its original embedding to inject document‑identity and ordering signals.

semantic_stage_groups.name: Hybrid‑attention encoding
semantic_stage_groups.purpose: Hybrid‑attention encoding: Feed the query and augmented passage embeddings into a Transformer encoder that applies shared full attention (global interactions) and dedicated masked attention (intra‑document interactions) in every layer, producing contextualized passage embeddings.

semantic_stage_groups.name: Contrastive training
semantic_stage_groups.purpose: Contrastive training: Using a contrastive InfoNCE loss, pull the updated positive passage embedding toward the fixed query embedding and push negative passage embeddings away.

semantic_stage_groups.name: Inference scoring and ranking
semantic_stage_groups.purpose: Inference scoring and ranking: Compute dot‑product similarities between the unchanged query embedding and the contextualized passage embeddings, then sort passages by descending score.
